description: Labelled "What changed" cards for lib/intelligence/changes.mjs. Each card: a followed story the reader last saw 3 h ago (seen article, published seen.hoursAgo ago) and one candidate new article. material = a reader following the story would want a card (a concrete new development: decision, event, ruling, data release, casualty count, market move). Immaterial = retelling/dup of seen coverage, explainer, opinion, preview, reaction roundup, speculation, or a word that merely looks like a trigger. material-late-indexed: published before the reader last looked but first indexed after (firstSeenHoursAgo). immaterial-stale: an old article (40 h) absorbed into the cluster later.
